gaps.title: NSG has no explicit rule overriding default internet outbound
gaps.detail: NSG 'demo-vnet-AzureBastionSubnet-nsg-australiaeast' has no explicit outbound rule at a priority lower than Azure's default AllowInternetOutBound rule (65001), so every attached subnet or NIC can reach the internet under Azure's silent default rather than a reviewed policy.
gaps.recommendation: Add an explicit outbound rule (priority < 65001) that allows or denies internet-bound traffic deliberately, instead of relying on the default AllowInternetOutBound rule.
gaps.basis: NSG outbound rule priorities against Azure's default security rules
